goblin_scouts.title: Goblin Scouts
goblin_scouts.description: Two goblin scouts block the road, bows already drawn.

orc_patrol.title: Orc Patrol
orc_patrol.description: An orc brute leads a goblin archer through the market edge.

bone_pack.title: Bone Pack
bone_pack.description: Two skeletons rise from the cellar dust, bones clicking.

wolf_pack.title: Wolf Pack
wolf_pack.description: A pair of lean wolves circle, looking for an opening.

waystation_chief.title: The Broken Waystation
waystation_chief.description: A bandit chief and two cutthroats have turned the ruined waystation into a fortified camp.

underroad_boss.title: The Underroad
underroad_boss.description: The Smuggler Lord and two tunnel runners guard the hidden cache beneath the waystation.

sanctum_boss.title: The Sealed Sanctum
sanctum_boss.description: The Rune Warden rises from its throne while two rune sentinels level their spears.

goblin_warband.title: Goblin Warband
goblin_warband.description: A bone-charmed goblin hexer drives two scouts forward, cursing the air ahead of them.

orc_raiders.title: Orc Raiders
orc_raiders.description: An orc berserker leads a raiding party down the road, axes already bloodied.

restless_dead.title: The Restless Dead
restless_dead.description: A risen champion in broken plate holds the cellar dark, two skeletons at its back.

underroad_enforcers.title: Smugglers' Enforcers
underroad_enforcers.description: A tunnel enforcer and two runners bar the way, cudgels and knives drawn.

runeheart_wardens.title: The Gate Wardens
runeheart_wardens.description: Two rune sentinels and a flickering echo of the Rune Warden guard the descent into the Runeheart Gate.

runeheart_sovereign.title: The Runeheart Sovereign
runeheart_sovereign.description: The heart of the gate unbinds itself: a white-hot sovereign of rune-stone with two echoes at its back.
